cases.name: rule 1 never reports
cases.new: for tree in sorted(denied & read & set()):
caught_by: a guard that says a tree is out of scope and reads it is reported
the other phrasings are read the same way

cases.name: rule 2 never reports
caught_by: a guard claiming to read a tree it has no path into is reported

cases.name: a bare tree name counts as a scope claim
caught_by: a tree named without a slash is prose, not a scope claim

cases.name: a claim may reach across a full stop
caught_by: a full stop between the tree and the phrase is not a claim

cases.name: any sentence with `reads` is a claim about this guard
caught_by: a mid-sentence mention of what another guard reads is not a claim
every guard here describes its own scope correctly

cases.name: only ROOT is followed, not REPO or a root parameter
caught_by: a root called REPO is followed like ROOT
and a root taken as a parameter, which is where most of them are
every guard here describes its own scope correctly

cases.name: the no-guards never-fires half is gone
caught_by: no guards at all is reported, not passed over

cases.name: the no-claims never-fires half is gone
caught_by: no scope claim anywhere is reported, not passed over

cases.name: the no-paths never-fires half is gone
cases.old: elif not any(roots(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for path in guards):
caught_by: no root path anywhere is reported, not passed over
